name: Chem Lab Renovation
brief: Renovate the second-floor chemistry teaching lab during the winter term. Strip the old fittings, remove two partition walls, rewire the lab with new power and data points, add plumbing for wet-lab sinks, install fume-hood ducting and fire safety, lay anti-static vinyl flooring, fit a false ceiling with LED lighting, and install new benches and storage. Needs a building permit and a fire inspection before handover. In-house works team plus contracted trades; the department wants the lab back for the new term, about fourteen weeks.

tasks.name: Strip old fittings and remove partition walls
Fit LED lighting in false ceiling

risks.title: Building permit approval delay
risks.event: Permit not issued by the planned date
risks.effect: Project start pushed back, delaying all downstream tasks
risks.response: Submit the application two weeks early and follow up weekly with the council

risks.title: Fire safety plan not approved on time
risks.cause: Supervisor omits required fire hazard analysis
risks.event: Fire safety plan returned for revisions
risks.response: Conduct a preliminary hazard review before formal submission

risks.title: Asbestos discovered during demolition
risks.cause: Old lab walls contain asbestos material
risks.event: Asbestos found when partition walls are stripped
risks.effect: Work stop for specialist removal, delaying demolition tasks
risks.response: Arrange an asbestos survey before demolition and have a licensed removal contractor on standby

risks.title: Layout drawings miss service coordination
risks.cause: Architect designs without updated electrical and plumbing routes
risks.effect: Redesign needed, delaying rewiring and plumbing works
risks.response: Hold a coordination workshop with electrician and plumber after completing layout drawings

risks.title: Anti‑static flooring delivery delay
risks.event: Vinyl flooring arrives four days late
risks.effect: Flooring installation cannot start, pushing subsequent fit‑out tasks
risks.response: Include a penalty clause in the supply contract and identify a secondary supplier as backup

risks.title: False ceiling conflicts with HVAC ducts
risks.cause: Inaccurate as‑built drawings of existing ductwork
risks.event: Ceiling crew discovers duct interference during installation
risks.effect: Ceiling redesign and extra labour add delay
risks.response: Verify HVAC routing on site before ceiling work and adjust design if needed

risks.title: Defective LED lighting fixtures
risks.cause: Batch of LEDs from new vendor is faulty
risks.effect: Re‑fit lighting required, delaying ceiling lighting and snagging
risks.response: Test a sample batch before full delivery and keep spare fixtures on site

risks.title: Insufficient conduit space for data points
risks.cause: Late change to bench layout increases cable density
risks.effect: Re‑routing of cables delays rewiring work
risks.response: Lock bench layout before rewiring and provision extra conduit capacity in the design

risks.title: Custom bench fabrication delay
risks.event: Benches and storage cabinets arrive five days late
risks.effect: Fit‑out of benches postponed, affecting snagging schedule
risks.response: Order cabinets with a firm delivery date and include liquidated damages for lateness

risks.title: Final fire inspection fails
risks.cause: Supervisor skips final functional test of fire safety equipment
risks.effect: Re‑commissioning needed, delaying handover to department
risks.response: Schedule a pre‑inspection functional test one week before the official fire inspection
